This collection contains a public campaign brief and page-linked YouTube content. It has no contracts, deadlines, creator fees, payments, orders, conversions, audience demographics or private campaign analytics. YouTube oEmbed provides title and publisher metadata, not views or sales. HTTP 200 verifies a metadata response only, not playback, content quality, sponsorship or contractual delivery. HTTP 404 or a request error means metadata was not verified in this check, not proof of deletion, non-delivery or wrongdoing. A page embed is a source-listed association, not a complete roster or proof of a paid partnership. Publishers may be brand channels. Historical campaign totals cannot be recalculated from current oEmbed metadata. Display names alone do not establish identity across platforms.
